name: X2-C3 Imperial astromech
description: X2-C3 Imperial astromechs was a line of highly versatile astromech droid for the Sith Empire. They employed an advanced sensor array and had impressive analytical abilities. Because of their flexibility and efficiency—including on the battlefield, where they made use of standard droid blaster attachments as well as a variety of specialized armaments—they were found on practically every Imperial military installation and ship.
